env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

cd dotted
logos build -o $WORK/bin/dotted$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr -count=1 'go: warning: \[portability::alias_extension\] main\.📜: loGo/s alias extension file'
! stderr 'error'
exists $WORK/bin/dotted$GOEXE
logos build ./lib
stderr -count=2 'portability::alias_extension'
stderr -count=1 'lib\.⚡:'
stderr -count=1 'lib_test\.⚡:'
cd ..

cd plain
logos build -o $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE
logos build ./lib
! stderr .
cd ..

cd canonical
logos build -o $WORK/bin/canonical$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/canonical$GOEXE
cd ..

cd gomod
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gomod$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

-- dotted/go.mod --
module example.com/dotted

go 1.27
-- dotted/cmd/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("dotted ok")
}
-- dotted/lib/lib.⚡ --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }
-- dotted/lib/lib_test.⚡ --
package lib

import "testing"

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "lib" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}
-- plain/go.mod --
module plain

go 1.27
-- plain/cmd/main.📜 --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("plain ok")
}
-- plain/lib/lib.⚡ --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }
-- plain/lib/lib_test.⚡ --
package lib

import "testing"

func TestName(t *testing.T) {
	if Name() != "lib" {
		t.Fatal("bad name")
	}
}
-- canonical/go.mod --
module example.com/canonical

go 1.27
-- canonical/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("canonical ok")
}
-- gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gomod

go 1.27
-- gomod/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("go ok")
}
